release_notes: v9.8.35 (export-timeout-adaptive) — TALLY WASN'T CRASHING, IT WAS OVERWHELMED. Krishna Sales Corp's v9.8.34 log showed the agent booting fine, loading 4244 stock items cleanly, then repeatedly hitting `Tally request timed out (30s)` on Sales voucher exports for April 2025 (this is a large ledger with 3 sales voucher types × 12 months). The 30 s timeout inherited from ping-style calls was simply too tight for a monthly EXPLODEFLAG=Yes Voucher-Register export on a busy ledger. Fix: (1) new EXPORT_TIMEOUT (default 180 s, override via env var) used only for heavy Export Data calls — voucher/receipt/purchase/credit-note/debit-note/journal/stock-journal/contra/balance-sheet; (2) new `_export_voucher_window` helper that, on timeout, ADAPTIVELY narrows the request to halves and continues splitting down to single-day granularity (6 levels) — a single slow week no longer stalls the whole month; (3) timeout error message now names the debug slug so support can pinpoint the offending voucher-type + window. GUID / multi-company / kill-switch code is unchanged and still active — Krishna's PC will now finish the sales sync it kept aborting. Rebuild via `build-kit\build.bat` and push the new .exe.
